name: What is involved in the sliding window replacement process?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the sliding window replacement process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The sliding window replacement process typically begins with an initial consultation and measurement. Once new windows are ordered and arrive, our team will prepare the work area, removing existing windows and clearing debris. New window frames are then installed, ensuring they are level and plumb, followed by sealing and insulation to prevent drafts and moisture. The sashes are inserted, and final adjustments are made for smooth operation. We conclude with a thorough cleanup and walk-through to ensure your satisfaction with the new installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes consultation, old window removal, new frame installation, sealing, sash insertion, and final adjustments. We ensure a clean, efficient installation.
